title: A view from the east: The Godin VI Oval and the Uruk Sphere
version: Journal of Archaeological Science: Reports 7, pp. 835–848, doi:10.1016/j.jasrep.2016.02.020.
lineage: Full publisher-formatted article displayed by author on Academia. Independent ceramic provenance measurements, not replication of the residue test.

passages.note: A sherd of the paired-handled type, GOT_20, has Godin Main fabric associated with a local clay source. Fig. 5 compares the type with Hamoukar. The study does not identify GOT_20 as the sherd that yielded the 1993 oxalate test.
The assemblages inside and outside the Oval were more integrated than an earlier enclave interpretation suggested. Vessel style alone was not a reliable proxy for clay provenance.
